<div class="atlas-purified-matrix"><style>

            --background-light: #ffffff;

        }

        /* --- Hero Section --- */

            text-align: center;

            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .hero h1 {

            color: white;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;

        }

        /* --- Buttons & CTAs --- */
        .cta-button {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--primary-gold), #b89a2d);

        }

        /* --- Why Choose Us Section --- */

        }

            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
        }
        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .feature-item {
            background: var(--background-light);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }
        .feature-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
        }
        .feature-icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            color: var(--primary-gold);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .feature-item h3 {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        /* --- Services & Pricing Table --- */
        .pricing-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin-top: 30px;

<script>
        // FAQ Accordion Logic
        const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
        faqItems.forEach(item => {
            const question = item.querySelector('.faq-question');
            question.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');
                faqItems.forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
                if (!isActive) {
                    item.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });

        // Popup Logic
        const popupOverlay = document.getElementById('quotePopupOverlay');
        const closePopupButton = document.getElementById('closePopup');
        const minimizedPopupIcon = document.getElementById('minimizedPopup');
        let popupShown = sessionStorage.getItem('popupShown');

        function showPopup() {
            popupOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => {
                popupOverlay.style.opacity = '1';
                popupOverlay.querySelector('.popup-container').style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }, 10);
            sessionStorage.setItem('popupShown', 'true');
        }

        function hidePopup() {
            popupOverlay.style.opacity = '0';
            popupOverlay.querySelector('.popup-container').style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                popupOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                minimizedPopupIcon.style.display = 'flex';
            }, 300);
        }

        // Show popup after 60 seconds if not already shown in this session
        if (!popupShown) {
            setTimeout(showPopup, 60000);
        }

        closePopupButton.addEventListener('click', hidePopup);
        minimizedPopupIcon.addEventListener('click', showPopup);
        popupOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === popupOverlay) {
                hidePopup();
            }
        });
    </script>

        <section id="ac-maintenance-guide">
            <div class="container">
                <h2 class="section-title">A Homeowner’s Guide to AC Maintenance</h2>
                <div style="display:flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;">
                     <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 300px;">
                        <p>While most people only think about their air conditioner when it breaks down in the peak of summer, proactive maintenance is crucial. Just like your car needs regular check-ups to avoid a sudden breakdown, your AC system requires attention to run efficiently and reliably. Regular maintenance not only prevents unexpected and costly repairs but also enhances your home’s air quality and saves you money on energy bills.</p>
                        <h3>Key Benefits of Regular AC Maintenance:</h3>
                        <ul>
                            <li><strong>Improved Indoor Air Quality:</strong> A clean system circulates cleaner, healthier air for your family.</li>
                            <li><strong>Enhanced Energy Efficiency:</strong> A well-maintained unit uses less power, significantly lowering your monthly electricity bills.</li>
                            <li><strong>Reduced Carbon Footprint:</strong> Efficient operation means less energy consumption, which is better for the environment.</li>
                            <li><strong>Extended Lifespan:</strong> Proper care can double the life of your AC unit, saving you from a costly early replacement.</li>
                            <li><strong>Peace of Mind:</strong> Eliminate the worry of sudden breakdowns and potential safety hazards.</li>
                        </ul>
                     </div>
                     <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 300px;">
                        <img decoding="async" src="https://atlasaircons.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Window-ac-Repair-service.webp" alt="Window AC Repair Service in Vadodara" style="width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:var(--border-radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow);" loading="lazy" title="">
                     </div>
                </div>
                <h3 style="text-align:center; margin-top: 50px;">DIY AC Maintenance Checklist</h3>
                <p style="text-align:center;">Here are some simple steps you can take to keep your AC in top shape. For anything more complex, like <a rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://atlasaircons.com/ac-gas-refilling/" target="_blank">AC gas refilling</a> or circuit repairs, it’s best to call a professional from Atlas Aircon.</p>
                <ol>
                    <li><strong>Turn Off The Power:</strong> For safety, always completely shut off power to both the indoor and outdoor units before starting any maintenance.</li>
                    <li><strong>Clean the Outdoor Unit (Condenser):</strong> Remove the fan cage and clear out any leaves, dirt, and debris from the interior.</li>
                    <li><strong>Clean and Straighten Fins:</strong> Gently spray the fins with a garden hose (not a pressure washer) from the inside out. Carefully use a butter knife or a fin comb to straighten any bent fins to ensure proper airflow.</li>
                    <li><strong>Clear the Area:</strong> Ensure there’s at least 2 feet of clear space around the outdoor unit for optimal airflow. Trim back any bushes or branches.</li>
                    <li><strong>Clean the Indoor Unit (Evaporator Coil):</strong> Open the blower unit’s panel, gently dust the evaporator coil, and spray it with a no-rinse coil cleaner. Clean the drain pan with soap and water.</li>
                    <li><strong>Unclog the Drain Line:</strong> Use a wet/dry vacuum at the end of the drain line to suck out any algae or mold buildup that could cause a blockage and water damage.</li>
                    <li><strong>Change the Blower Filter:</strong> Replace the filter at least twice a year—before summer and winter. A clean filter is vital for good airflow and efficiency.</li>
                </ol>
            </div>
